name: Navigation help
description: Help mode entries for Molly's Navigation plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Navigation
entries.text: Tap an app to open it and slide open its own pages under it. Right-click the navigation for Navigation settings.

entries.title: Navigation item
entries.text: Opens this page. An item with an arrow opens a sub menu; tap it again on its own page to close it.

entries.title: Navigation settings
entries.text: Colours, fonts, icons, density, width, the sub-menu animation, behaviour and the order of the apps. Changes show at once and apply in every app that uses sub menus.

entries.title: Collapse to icons
entries.text: Folds the navigation to its icons, or opens it again.

entries.title: Reset navigation
entries.text: Drops every change and goes back to the preset.
